scheme_name: IGNOAPS (Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme)
authority: Ministry of Rural Development, Govt of India & State Social Welfare Dept
benefit: Monthly pension of ₹1,000–₹2,500 direct to bank account (Central ₹200-₹500 + State top-up)

criteria.label: Senior citizen age qualification (60 years or older)
criteria.plain_description: The claimant must be at least 60 years of age on the date of application.
criteria.remediation: Upload Aadhaar Card or Voter ID proving age of 60 years or above.

criteria.label: Belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) household
criteria.plain_description: Applicant's family must be listed in the official BPL census or hold a certified BPL card.
criteria.remediation: Upload BPL Certificate or BPL Ration Card.

criteria.label: Identity & DBT bank account verification
criteria.plain_description: Valid Aadhaar-linked single bank account is mandatory for DBT pension disbursement.
criteria.source_clause: NSAP Guidelines Section 5 (Direct Benefit Transfer Mode)
criteria.remediation: Upload copy of Aadhaar card linked with active bank account.

application.office_name: Block Development Officer (BDO) / Municipal Social Welfare Office
documents_to_carry: Original Aadhaar Card and 3 passport size photos
BPL Ration Card or Ward Member BPL certificate
Bank Account Passbook (Single account with IFSC)
process_steps: Submit application at the Gram Panchayat office, BDO office, or online on NSAP portal
Physical verification conducted by Social Welfare Inspector within 30 days
Pension sanctioned order issued by Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM)
Monthly pension disbursed into account on 1st week of every month
